constraints: Probe must run on a different machine with no install and no network
Probe must never write to a field .twining/ store
Thresholds must be fixed before first field run to keep the result falsifiable
context: Built read-only field probe + pre-registered validation doc; dogfood baseline already refutes the review's strongest capture claim
rationale: an exploratory report invites reading the numbers to fit the conclusions already written, whereas a threshold fixed in advance can return REFUTES and did so on 3 of 12 rows against our own store
summary: Chose pre-registered hypotheses with explicit falsification thresholds recorded before the script was ever run against a store, rather than an open-ended metrics dump
